knowledge.answer: ESP32 is a microcontroller platform with Wi-Fi and Bluetooth capabilities, dual-core Xtensa CPU, and 520KB SRAM.
CHARRMPASS is an RFID-based vehicle entry and exit monitoring system using RC522/PN532 and relay gate control.
ESP32 microSD SPI wiring: CS is GPIO 5, SCK is GPIO 18, MOSI is GPIO 23, MISO is GPIO 19, VCC is 3.3V or 5V, GND is Ground.
R.A.N. stands for Raian AI Network, an embedded local AI assistant running on ESP32 with microSD memory.
